complete_pass.raw_ids: Every relevant emitted concrete ID must map unambiguously to a selected ID; all observed parameter cases must be paired; unidentified/ambiguous outputs and unsupported result formats preclude a complete PASS.
complete_pass.runner_evidence: Raw output plus batch exit/completion evidence must be retained; absent capture proof is UNVERIFIABLE.
complete_pass.selected_outcomes: Every selected ID must have identifiable terminal base and patched outcomes; NOT_RUN/TIMEOUT are gaps, not terminal evidence. ERROR/runner infrastructure failures preclude a complete PASS. Explicit skips are terminal recorded outcomes.

historical_absence: A missing historical raw record is an evidence gap, never an invented NOT_RUN or timeout. Would-be PASS becomes INCOMPLETE with state UNVERIFIABLE.
migration: Only PASS -> INCOMPLETE; FAIL, NOT_AVAILABLE and BASELINE_UNRELIABLE remain unchanged. Keep original verdict beside new.
policy: Decision rules in decision.py unchanged; native INCOMPLETE adapts to existing unavailable signal vocabulary. Classifier only logs shadow suggestions; no decision suppression.
regression_precedence: FAIL remains FAIL despite other incompleteness. Preserve legacy parser/scorer classifications alongside raw accounting; do not retroactively turn previously ignored IDs into FAIL or erase historical FAILs.
